top_signals.title: US to Open More Ports to Mexican Cattle in Beef Supply Boost
top_signals.summary: Agriculture Secretary Brooke Rollins said the US will allow Mexican cattle shipments into two additional US ports over the next two months, in a move poised to boost beef supplies.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: Trump Vows to Double Canadian Auto Tariffs, Escalating Fight
top_signals.summary: Bloomberg's Melissa Shin said that negotiators in both Canada and the United States understand how important the auto sector is both countries as President Trump vowed to double existing tariffs on the Canadian auto industry. Shin said that the broader tariffs stand to impact an estimated 90,000 jobs and disproportionately small businesses that may not see as much government support.  (Source: Bloomberg)
